# colourspace

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:colourspace`](gmeow-colourspace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/colourspace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The colourspace reference frame in which this media object's pixel values are expressed — sRGB, Adobe RGB, CMYK, CIE XYZ, etc. A subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)). Multiple colourspace claims for the same image coexist as separate standpoint-indexed assertions ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), each attributable and confidence-weighted. Not declared FunctionalProperty in the logical core to avoid incorrect [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) inferences when merging standpoints; single-valued constraint is enforced by SHACL (sh:maxCount 1).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the colourspace reference frame in which a media object's pixel values are expressed — sRGB, Adobe RGB, CMYK; the frame that satisfies [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md)'s [`gmeow:requiresFrame`](gmeow-requiresFrame.md) declaration ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid leaving pixel values frameless (a value asserted without its frame is ill-formed) and avoid forcing one colourspace by making it functional — competing standpoint-indexed claims coexist; SHACL enforces single-valued, not OWL ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) at a [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) via [`gmeow:colourspace`](gmeow-colourspace.md) (a [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md) subproperty); carry conflicting colourspace claims as separate attributable, confidence-weighted assertions.

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:colourspace`](gmeow-colourspace.md) ex:sRGB.
